zh: n 最多 1000，子数组大约 50 万个，可以全部枚举。
平均值恰好为整数 x，等价于“区间和 = 长度 × x”，用整除判断即可，避免浮点误差。
外层枚举左端，内层右移右端并累加区间和；若 和 % 长度 == 0，就把 和/长度 对应的计数加一；最后依次输出 x=1..n 的计数。
en: n is at most 1000, so there are only about half a million subarrays, few enough to enumerate.
The mean equals an integer x exactly when sum = length × x, so a divisibility check avoids floating-point error.
Loop over the left end and extend the right end while accumulating the sum; whenever sum % length == 0, increment the count for sum/length. Finally print the counts for x=1..n.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate the left and right ends, accumulating the range sum incrementally; when the sum is divisible by the length, add 1 to the count of the corresponding mean.

## Proof of correctness

Enumerating all right ends for each left end produces every non-empty contiguous range exactly once, and the maintained sum is exact because it is accumulated term by term. The mean is an integer x if and only if sum = length × x, and the divisibility check has no floating-point error; since the permutation values lie in 1..n, the mean lies in that range too.

## Complexity

O(n²) time and O(n) space.
